m.s: Rinse {rice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with 1½ times its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 10 minutes so it finishes steaming.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook finely diced {onion} for 8 minutes until soft and golden. Add crushed {garlic} and grated {ginger} and stir for 1 minute.
Add {currypaste} and fry for 2 minutes, stirring, until it smells toasty and starts to stick to the pan a little.
Add {tintom}, {coconut} and {chickpeas}, drained and rinsed. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then. Crush some of the chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken the sauce.
Stir through {spinach} until it wilts. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon if you have one.
Warm {naan} in a dry pan or the oven. Serve the curry over the rice with {yoghurt} for dolloping, the naan and torn {coriander}.

l: Freezes and reheats well. Great for a meat-free day. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
g: GF wraps or extra rice instead of naan, and check the curry paste.
